terms.intro1: By using the ‘Send money to someone in prison’ service you agree to our privacy policy and to these terms and conditions.
terms.purposeHeading: Purpose of these terms and conditions
terms.purpose1: These terms and conditions affect your rights and liabilities under the law.
terms.purpose2: They govern your use of, and relationship with, the ‘Send money to someone in prison’ service.
terms.purpose3: They don’t apply to other services provided by the Ministry of Justice or to any other department or service which is linked to this service.
terms.update1: We may occasionally update these terms and conditions.
terms.update2: This might happen if there’s a change in the law or to the way this service works.
terms.update3: We recommend you check this page regularly for any updates.
terms.disagree: If you don’t agree to the terms and conditions set out in this document, you should not send money to prisoners using this service.
terms.payments1: You can only use debit cards on this service – Visa, Mastercard and Maestro.
terms.payments1b: You cannot use credit cards or prepaid cards.
terms.payments2: When using this service your payment will be checked by HM Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) to ensure that it is from a legitimate source and for a legitimate purpose.
terms.payments2b: If HMPPS believes the money is suspicious, your payment will be rejected, and the money will be returned to your account.
terms.payments3: Your payment may take up to 5 days to be processed while the compliance check is carried out.
terms.payments4: If your payment is rejected by our compliance check, this may lead to further investigation and possible referral to the police if it is thought that an offence has been committed.
terms.payments5: Information recorded on this system may be used in the investigation of money laundering or other offences by HMPPS or its partners.

terms.responsible2: It’s your responsibility to be aware of these risks and to avoid using any computer which may leave your personal information accessible to others.
terms.responsible3: Do not leave a public computer unattended and ensure your personal data is wiped from the system when you log out.
terms.responsible4: You are responsible if you choose to leave a computer unprotected while in the process of sending money to a prisoner.
terms.responsible5: We make every effort to check and test this service whenever we amend or update it.
terms.responsible6: However, you must take your own precautions to ensure that the way you access this service does not expose you to the risk of viruses, malicious computer code or other forms of interference which may damage your own computer system.
terms.responsible7a: You must not misuse our service by knowingly introducing viruses, trojans, worms, logic bombs or other material which is malicious or technologically harmful.
